servedBundle.statement: Measured before any capture. The served index.html is byte-identical to this repository's dist/index.html and the served entry script contains this release id, so every reading below is from THIS build. Any of those failing aborts the run rather than being recorded as a caveat.

capAtMeasurement.statement: THE 512-ENTRY CAP WAS IN FORCE FOR EVERY READING BELOW AND THIS PROMOTION DID NOT CHANGE IT. This promotion consumes the 36-entry reservation T020's split committed to this wave rather than cutting a new share or raising a cap, so both cache caps are exactly what T018 left them. The values here are read from EXTERIOR_RUNTIME_BUDGETS in the same tree the served bundle was built from rather than typed into this record, so a reading taken at a different cap cannot be presented as a reading at this one.

note: T022 promotion acceptance, and the last one this ledger can produce. The PROMOTED DEFAULT COMPOSITION — Block 835 V3, Midtown-core V3, and the Lower-Manhattan, Southern-remainder, Central-and-upper-Manhattan and Northern-Manhattan P1 successors streaming together over the pinned manhattan-citywide-20260804 base — measured in the production preview build by the shipping CesiumJS renderer, with Chrome's vsync and frame-rate limit disabled, at the UNCHANGED 512-entry cache cap. A SIX-wave composition had never been measured before this run; T020 measured five. The capped control is captured in a second browser, GPU texture memory is labelled COMPUTED because it is computed, and isolated slow frames are STATED rather than smoothed: `cappedControl` is the reading that proves this run is uncapped, `gpuTextureArithmetic` is computed and is not measured anywhere in this file, and every station carries `worstObservedFrameMilliseconds` beside its medians. WHAT THIS MEASUREMENT IS NOT: it is not evidence that the city is textured. Six of six waves have a promoted default and they ship 498 assets against a pinned base of 45,194 canonical buildings, so what is measured here is a composition of six small curated subsets streaming together, which is exactly what the promotion record claims and nothing more.

cappedControl.statement: The same station in a second Chrome launched WITHOUT the uncapping flags. Its p50 is the display's present interval; the uncapped run's p50 sitting far below it is what makes the uncapped numbers a headroom measurement rather than a floor reading.

stillCapture.statement: The app's overlay chrome and fallback notices are hidden for the SCREENSHOT ONLY, injected after every timed frame was rendered with them on screen. No measured frame had less work in it than a real session's.

gpuTextureArithmetic.statement: Decoded-plus-mipmapped texture memory for the shipped subset, computed as width * height * 4 * 1.33 * imageCount from the emitted bytes. GPU texture memory was NOT measured: no instrument reachable from this session reports texture VRAM, and usedJSHeapSize does not stand in for it. This is an upper bound on an all-resident scene and it is arithmetic.
gpuTextureArithmetic.otherPromotedWavesNote: The Block 835 V3 and Midtown-core V3 waves are TEXTURE-FREE releases and contribute nothing. The Lower-Manhattan P1, Southern-remainder P1 and Central-and-upper-Manhattan P1 waves are NOT: all three are textured LOD 0, over 71, 179 and 40 assets, and each computes its own share in its own T016, T018 and T020 record. The figure above is THIS release's share alone and must not be read as the whole promoted composition's; `promotedCompositionNote` states how the sum is formed.
gpuTextureArithmetic.promotedCompositionNote: FOUR of the six promoted waves carry tiles, and this is the last wave, so the sum is now closed: adding this release's computed share to the T016, T018 and T020 records' gives the whole promoted composition's computed upper bound. All four are arithmetic and none is a measurement.

cacheResidency.statement: One DISTINCT fetched GLB is one LRU entry, so the entry count is the count of distinct GLB URLs the session completed and the byte figure is the encoded size of every response. RESPONSES AND DISTINCT ARTIFACTS ARE COUNTED SEPARATELY BECAUSE AT SIX WAVES THEY CAN DIFFER: the cache holds 512 entries, a six-wave session gets close to that, and an evicted artifact that comes back into view is fetched a second time, which would show up as two responses for one entry. WHETHER THEY DID DIFFER IS A READING RATHER THAN AN ASSUMPTION, and `perRun` carries both numbers for every capture so it can be read off rather than inferred. In THIS run they differed in 1 of 12 captures, by at most 3 response(s) — so eviction and re-fetch inside a single session is observed here rather than hypothesised. Two things this figure is NOT. It is not the in-app cache counter, which only reaches the DOM in a VITE_BLOCK835_PROBE build, and this measurement is deliberately against the ordinary production preview a user gets. And it is not a measurement of CONCURRENT residency: distinct-over-the-whole-session is itself an upper bound, because an artifact fetched early and evicted later is counted here and is not resident at the end. So the entry figure bounds occupancy from above by construction, and the honest statement is that it stayed inside the cap, not that the cache held exactly that many at any instant.

releaseTimeDerivation.note: The RELEASE-TIME derivation counts GLB FILES ON DISK: 28 for Block 835 V3, which ships two LODs per building, 156 for Midtown-core V3, 71 for Lower-Manhattan P1, 179 for Southern-remainder P1, 40 for Central-and-upper-Manhattan P1 and 24 for this release. At runtime a session fetches fewer, because only the selected LOD is requested — the T016 record measured 14 Block 835 GLBs against 28 on disk — so the disk derivation is CONSERVATIVE rather than wrong, and `worstObserved` above is what this session actually made resident. An immutable release must be sized against the release-time number, which is why both are recorded. THIS IS THE LEDGER-WIDE END STATE: six of six declared waves are promoted, they occupy 498 of 512 entries, and the 14 that remain are headroom with no unpromoted wave left to reserve them for. This promotion spent 24 of the 36 entries T020's split reserved for it and left 12 unspent, because the curated cell's four edge-neighbours own 40, 41, 53 and 89 buildings and the contiguity precondition refuses a second, non-adjacent island. The cache cap was NOT raised.

stations.note: Standing EAST of curated cell 727 and looking WEST along the West 125th Street corridor, on the inspection profile at a shallow pitch. Shallow and low on purpose: facades are vertical, and the T017 evidence records a station that looked at rooftops and produced byte-identical stills. The camera is roughly 290 m outside the cell's eastern bound, so the whole 231-metre curated block band and its 101.5 m sourced structure are in frame with the untextured base massing of the tombstoned cells behind and beside it. This is the pose where a viewer can see, in one frame, that the promoted subset is ONE small block of textured ground in a wave that is otherwise base massing.

The wide skyline station for the newly promoted cell, read from the south-east at about a kilometre. It is the honest counterpart to wave w04's Central Park West skyline station: this wave's tallest admissible structure is 101.5 m rather than 219.2 m, so what this station shows is a single tall building over four- to eight-storey Harlem stock, which is what northern Manhattan is. It is also past the LOD 0 cut-off, where a 128-pixel tile is repeated most per screen pixel and aliasing shows first.

The SIX-WAVE wide view, and the station this promotion exists to measure. A high pose south of the island looking north up Manhattan, at the altitude and pitch where the ground of all SIX promoted waves — Block 835, Midtown-core, Lower-Manhattan, Southern-remainder, Central-and-upper-Manhattan and Northern-Manhattan — is inside one frustum rather than merely simultaneously promoted. A six-wave composition had never been measured; T020's wide station was framed for five and could not have held Harlem.

The T020 Central-and-upper-Manhattan station, pose-for-pose UNCHANGED, kept for continuity across the two promotions. Its numbers are directly comparable with the T020 record's, so "did adding a sixth wave cost the fifth one anything" is a comparison rather than an assertion.
